item.title: EplayerX 1.2.54
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 首页「今日更新」新增播出时间和剧集信息展示，并可查看完整列表。 - 优化首页和详情页卡片布局，减少滚动时的重复布局与预告片资源占用。 - 修复后台通知刷新首页时可能发生的崩溃。 - 改进异常字幕和特殊字符的处理，增强字幕显示稳定性。 - 改进部分 HEVC 片源的播放时序，修复缓存读取异常，提升播放与恢复的稳定性。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本。请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Today’s Updates on Home now shows air times and episode information, with access to the full list. - Improved Home and detail card layouts, reducing repeated layout work while scrolling and resource usage for trailers. - Fixed a possible crash when background notifications refresh Home. - Improved handling of malformed subtitles and special characters for more reliable subtitle display. - Improved playback timing for some HEVC sources and fixed cache reading errors for more reliable playback and recovery.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
